judge.rationale: The candidate delivers a clean, bug-free implementation that meets every acceptance criterion, including explicitly mentioning `src/types/ai.ts` by introducing a structurally identical `TurnUsage` type to satisfy the requirement that 'the type of what the hook receives makes the answer unambiguous'. In contrast to the reference, which simply renamed the parameter to `totalUsage?: UsageMetadata` and accumulated inline inside `chatOrchestrator.ts`, the candidate extracted `sumReportedUsage` into `orchestratorHelpers.ts` and placed the new acceptance tests in a separate test file (`chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts`). Two minor deviations from the reference are placing the new `afterModelResponse` behavior in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' heading rather than promoting it to the main spec section, and placing the `CHANGELOG.md` entry under `### Fixed` rather than `### Changed`.
